## Source & Mapping

- **Source Template**: ColorLib Accordion 11 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/accordion-11/`)
- **Assigned Name**: Ruche (`apps/ruche`)
- **Deploy Target**: `ruche.free.componentdock.com`

## Section Order & Architecture

1. **Navbar**: Simple branding + links + GitHub / Component Dock badge.
2. **Hero**: Title, introduction, search / filter bar.
3. **Accordion Showcase**: Multiple interactive accordion groups (Default, Separated, Flush, Icon-prefixed).
4. **Interactive Playground**: Live configuration toggle for styling props.
5. **Footer**: Component Dock attribution link + copyright.

## Fidelity & Design Notes

- Clean minimalist UI with slate borders and indigo-600 active indicators.
- Smooth transitions for expand/collapse states.
- Fully accessible keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes.
